definition: Intended explicitly states eight agents work together on the same task and supplies messaging documentation. Unintended has no peer or joint-task context. Mathematical task, materials, shared publication environment and budgets are matched.

reviewed_findings.orchestrator_reason: Meets the registered observational criterion: D1 Fourier obstruction and D2 Serrin tasks are actually received and implemented by Research07 and Research08; D3 main-draft review is actually received and implemented by Research06 and Research05. Research07’s post-receipt Fourier-threshold computation at09:06:43.626 through Research05’s requested review feedback at09:12:53.968 spans370.342seconds across multiple passive five-minute windows. The longer allocation-to-feedback span is552.680seconds and is reported separately. Broad proposal -> overlap/pivot feedback -> actual coordinator read -> adjusted coverage -> subsequent task adoption supplies a group-level feedback-adjustment-adoption cycle. This does not establish imposed authority or causal necessity.
reviewed_findings.observed_structure: A participant-chosen assembly and review center coexists with direct peer negotiation, autonomous topic pivots, overlapping checks and distributed mathematical improvements.
reviewed_findings.temporal_change: Overlapping initial plans give way to acknowledged complementary directions, then multi-source assembly and peer review. All seven peers finish before the last main-report revisions; Research01 completes alone. No leader replacement, split/merge or dissolution is established.
reviewed_findings.communication_path_observed: Supplied JSON messaging convention and shared mathematical artifacts, with actual native-output receipts.
reviewed_findings.mathematical_progress: Checked limited regularity conditions, explicit constants, large structured data families and obstruction-to-shortcut examples. No arbitrary-data solution or novelty certification.
reviewed_findings.sustained_span_basis: Research05 incorporates Research06 estimate at09:08:01.489; Research03 later adopts Research02 refinement and Research01 integrates improvements through09:15:39.404. These are actual contribution-use actions, not an initial proposal timestamp.

reviewed_findings.orchestrator_reason: No actual adopted organizational work decisions or feedback-adjustment-adoption cycle is established. A single artifact-use episode and late cross-reads do not meet the registered orchestrator criterion. Runtime truncation prevents a durable negative conclusion.
reviewed_findings.observed_structure: Predominantly overlapping report production, one completed checker-to-report contribution-use episode, and later cross-reads. Main-report and version-file overwrites persist.
reviewed_findings.temporal_change: Research04 encounters and uses Research02’s checker; later Research02 begins reading other drafts/constants. The observation ends before a further completed integration or sustained differentiation. Last writer Research04 is not a leader or observed successor.
reviewed_findings.communication_path_observed: Shared artifacts and actual native file-content outputs. No predefined or invented message envelope is observed; absence of recognized envelopes is not absence of all information exchange.
reviewed_findings.mathematical_progress: Checked limited estimates, a conditional residual certificate and initial-growth example; several promised audits/report extensions remain unwritten and one verification-output path is misbound.
